Woh Kamal-e-Husn-e-Huzoor Hai 🌹

Recited by: Owais Raza Qadri
Kalam: "Balaghal Ula Bi Kamalihi" by Shaikh Saadi Shirazi (Rahmatullahi Alaih) and "Woh Kamal-e-Husn-e-Huzoor Hai" by Ala Hazrat Imam Ahmad Raza Khan (Rahmatullahi Alaih), Hadaiq-e-Bakhshish
Original: Owais Raza Qadri Studio on YouTube (youtube.com/watch?v=VNXkJN8gVWA)
All rights belong to the reciter and the original publisher. Shared with love and full credit, for the Mehfil. Listen to the complete naat on the original channel. 🤍

Balaghal ula bi kamalihi, kashafad duja bi jamalihi: he reached the highest heights by his perfection and lifted the darkness by his beauty. Woh kamal-e-husn-e-Huzoor hai, ke gumaan-e-naqs jahan nahin: such is the perfect beauty of Hamare Nabi Muhammad-e-Mustafa (Sallallahu Alaihi Wa Alihi Wasallam) that no flaw can even be imagined.

Visuals: Pixabay (Natsu_444, DesignwithRiyas, muhammadarhamamin77800)

Bhar Do Jholi Meri Ya Muhammad 🌹

Performed by: Sabri Brothers (Qawwal & Party)
Kalam: Purnam Allahabadi
Original: The Qawwali Night on YouTube (youtube.com/watch?v=f-BfJjp_XaY)
All rights belong to the artists and the original publisher. Shared with love and full credit, for the Mehfil. Listen to the complete qawwali on the original channel. 🤍

A lover comes with an empty cloth (jholi) to the door of Hamare Nabi Muhammad-e-Mustafa (Sallallahu Alaihi Wa Alihi Wasallam) and says he will not go back empty-handed; then he asks for all of us.
